scope: structure and spec inventory; not behavioral execution

definitions.name: gate-check
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — All Concept artifacts present, advancing to Systems Design
### Case 2: Failure Path — Missing required artifacts for Concept → Systems Design
### Case 3: No Argument — Auto-detect current stage
### Case 4: Edge Case — Manual check items: "I don't know" is not "not yet"
### Case 5: Director Gate — panel existence (`review_mode`) vs panel width (`workflow`)
### Case 6: Director context — a later phase's artifact is "not expected", never "none"
### Case 7: CONCERNS override — the user accepts the risks; a FAIL is never overridden
### Case 8: `/gate-check production` at `workflow: minimal` — the slice items drop
### Case 9: A gate its tier file marks "not applicable"
### Case 10: Minimal-tier closing route — a built game with no brief is sent to `/reverse-document`

definitions.name: design-review
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Complete GDD, all 8 sections present
### Case 2: Failure Path — Incomplete GDD (4/8 sections at `full`)
### Case 3: Partial Path — `standard` tier, numeric rules with no Formulas section
### Case 4: Edge Case — File not found
### Case 5: Review mode — specialist delegation in `full`, none in `lean` / `solo`
### Case 6: Review mode from the resolved config — no flag

definitions.name: story-readiness
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Fully ready story
### Case 2: Blocked Path — Referenced ADR is Proposed (not Accepted)
### Case 3: Needs Work — Missing Acceptance Criteria (checked at every tier)
### Case 4: Edge Case — Stale manifest version
### Case 5: Director Gate — QL-STORY-READY behavior across review modes
### Case 6: UI story at `qa.level: minimal` — the screenshot plan is never waived
### Case 7: NOT ASSESSED — nothing to evaluate, or an ADR nobody can read
### Case 8: A Deprecated or Superseded ADR blocks, and the fix points at the story's ADR field
### Case 9: A deprecated or superseded TR-ID needs work, quoted or not

definitions.name: story-done
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — All acceptance criteria met, no deviations
### Case 2: Criteria needing manual or playtest verification
### Case 3: Blocked Path — GDD deviation detected
### Case 4: Edge Case — No argument, auto-detect current story
### Case 5: Director Gate — LP-CODE-REVIEW across review modes
### Case 6: UI story at `minimal`, no sprint plan — the screenshot closes it
### Case 7: NOT ASSESSED — a criterion nobody could evaluate
### Case 8: Reference files are read only on the branch that needs them

definitions.name: review-all-gdds
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Clean GDD set with no conflicts
### Case 2: Failure Path — Conflicting rules between two GDDs
### Case 3: Partial Path — Cross-reference to a GDD that does not exist
### Case 4: Edge Case — Fewer than two system GDDs
### Case 5: Director Gate — none spawned, whatever the review mode
### Case 6: NOT ASSESSED — fewer than two readable GDDs
### Case 7: Phase files are read on demand, and again after a compaction
### Case 8: `since-last-review` — scope comes from the script, not from reasoning over git
### Case 9: Focus modes — one pass runs, and the report says which did not

definitions.name: architecture-review
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — every requirement covered by an Accepted ADR
### Case 2: Failure Path — Foundation gap plus a cross-ADR ownership conflict
### Case 3: Partial Path — coverage resting on a Proposed ADR
### Case 4: Edge Case — missing architecture document; malformed ADRs
### Case 5: Engine specialist consultation — configured vs unconfigured engine

definitions.name: create-epics
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Two approved GDDs create two epics
### Case 2: Failure Path — No system GDDs found
### Case 3: Director Gate — Full mode spawns PR-EPIC before writing
### Case 4: Edge Case — Untraced requirements at full workflow
### Case 5: Director Gate — PR-EPIC returns CONCERNS
### Case 6: Edge Case — An EPIC.md already exists for one system
### Case 7: Standard tier — GDDs without `## Summary`, one untraced non-critical requirement

definitions.name: create-stories
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Epic with 3 stories, all ADRs Accepted
### Case 2: Failure Path — Named epic does not exist
### Case 3: Blocked Story — ADR is Proposed
### Case 4: Edge Case — No argument provided
### Case 5: Director Gate — Full mode, one story returns GAPS from QL-STORY-READY
### Case 6: Minimal tier — epic synthesized from the brief, then a return visit

definitions.name: dev-story
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Logic story implemented at full workflow
### Case 2: Failure Path — Referenced ADR is Proposed
### Case 2b: Failure Path — Proposed ADR at the `full` tier
### Case 3: ADR changed since the story was written
### Case 4: Edge Case — No argument; reads from session state
### Case 5: Minimal tier, Logic story — tests waived
### Case 5b: Minimal tier, UI story — the screenshot is still required
### Case 6: Unity — code under `Assets/`, capture script asked for
### Case 7: Engine unset — the code root is unresolved, nothing is written
### Case 8: Dependency marked Complete through option [C]
### Case 9: The agent stops early — INCOMPLETE, and the checkpoint says resume
### Case 10: `full` tier, a story with no governing ADR (`ADR: N/A`)
### Case 11: Two TR-IDs share a prefix — the registry lookup matches the exact id

definitions.name: create-control-manifest
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — 4 Accepted ADRs create a correct manifest
### Case 2: Failure Path — No ADRs found
### Case 3: Mixed ADR Statuses — Only Accepted ADRs included
### Case 4: Edge Case — Regenerating an existing manifest
### Case 5: Director Gate — TD-MANIFEST in full review mode returns REJECT
### Case 6: Edge Case — No Accepted ADR, and ADRs with no `## Status`

definitions.name: propagate-design-change
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — GDD formula change affects one of two referencing ADRs
### Case 2: Zero matches — "no impact" versus "cannot trace"
### Case 3: Edge Case — Empty diff on a GDD with history
### Case 4: Edge Case — No argument provided
### Case 5: Director Gate — TD-CHANGE-IMPACT returns CONCERNS in full mode
### Case 6: Workflow tiers — `minimal` stops before the cascade; `standard` narrows it

definitions.name: architecture-decision
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — New rendering ADR, full mode, TD-ADR approves
### Case 2: Failure Path — TD-ADR returns CONCERNS
### Case 3: Lean and Solo Modes — TD-ADR skipped; checks that cannot run say so
### Case 4: Edge Case — Proposed decision contradicts a registered stance
### Case 5: Acceptance Mode — Status moves to Accepted only through `accept`
### Case 5b: Acceptance Mode — a story that names the ADR only as a successor is left out
### Case 6: Retrofit — Missing Status answered `Accepted`

definitions.name: map-systems
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Concept decomposed and index written in full review mode
### Case 2: Failure Path — No game concept found
### Case 3: Director Gate — CD-SYSTEMS returns CONCERNS after the write
### Case 4: Edge Case — Systems index already exists
### Case 5: Director Gate — Lean and solo modes skip all three gates, noted
### Case 6: Guided mode — a new index is still asked for; an update is not
### Case 7: Director Gate — TD-SYSTEM-BOUNDARY returns REJECT

definitions.name: vertical-slice
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — slice built, played unaided, PROCEED
### Case 2: Failure Path — a built slice with a NO cannot PROCEED
### Case 3: Mode Variant — CD-PLAYTEST in full, skipped in lean and solo
### Case 4: Edge Case — the slice is built but nobody has played it
### Case 5: Director Gate — CD-PLAYTEST returns REJECT, CONCERNS or NOT ASSESSED
### Case 6: Minimal workflow — PROCEED routes to stories and the velocity feeds the brief

definitions.name: design-system
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — New combat GDD, full mode, full workflow
### Case 2: Retrofit Mode — Fill only the incomplete sections at standard tier
### Case 3: Director Gate — CD-GDD-ALIGN returns CONCERNS, REJECT or NOT ASSESSED
### Case 4: Lean and Solo Modes — Gate skipped once; specialist spawns follow their own checks
### Case 5: Missing Input and Declined Skeleton
### Case 6: Minimal Project, One System Raised by `system_overrides`
### Case 7: Phase Files Are Read Before Each Phase, and Again After a Compaction
### Case 8: Populated Registry and Numbered-Heading Dependency GDDs — Block-form greps find the facts

definitions.name: consistency-check
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Registry and 4 GDDs agree
### Case 2: Failure Path — A GDD contradicts a registered constant
### Case 3: Stale Registry — The source GDD changed after the registry entry
### Case 4: Edge Case — Empty registry, no GDDs
### Case 4b: Edge Case — Registry populated, but no GDD in scope
### Case 4c: Edge Case — Named entity is not in the registry
### Case 5: Director Gate — No gate spawned in full review mode
### Case 6: Standard Workflow — Only the required GDD sections are compared
### Case 6b: Standard Workflow — A per-system override makes one GDD `full`
### Case 7: Registry Changed Since Phase 1 — re-read, then anchor each Edit on the current text

definitions.name: sprint-plan
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Ready backlog generates sprint
### Case 2: Blocked Path — No stories in the backlog
### Case 3: Gate returns CONCERNS — Sprint overloaded, revised before write
### Case 4: Lean Mode — PR-SPRINT skipped, QA plan check still runs
### Case 5: Edge Case — Previous sprint still has open stories
### Case 6: Gate returns UNREALISTIC — Stories deferred before the write
### Case 7: Gate returns NOT ASSESSED — No story estimates

definitions.name: sprint-status
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Mixed sprint, At Risk with a blocked Must Have
### Case 2: All Stories Complete — On Track with completion flag
### Case 3: No Sprint Files — Guidance to run /sprint-plan
### Case 4: Edge Case — Stale In Progress Story (flagged)
### Case 5: Gate Compliance — Read-only; no gate invocation
### Case 6: Default Minimal Workflow — Build-order progress, no sprint files
### Case 7: Minimal Workflow — Every unfinished story Blocked or Draft

definitions.name: team-ui
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Full pipeline from UX spec through polish succeeds
### Case 2: UX Review Gate — Spec fails review; skill halts before implementation
### Case 3: No Argument — Usage guidance shown
### Case 4: Accessibility Parallel Review — Phase 4 runs three streams simultaneously
### Case 5: Missing Interaction Pattern Library — Skill notes the gap rather than inventing patterns
### Case 6: `review_mode` gates nothing — art-director stays in the roster at lean and solo

definitions.name: team-combat
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — All agents succeed, full pipeline runs to completion
### Case 2: Blocked Agent — One subagent returns BLOCKED mid-pipeline
### Case 3: No Argument — Clear usage guidance shown
### Case 4: Parallel Phase Validation — Phase 3 agents run simultaneously
### Case 5: Architecture Phase Engine Routing — Engine specialist resolved from config

definitions.name: team-narrative
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — All five phases complete, narrative doc delivered
### Case 2: Lore Contradiction Found — world-builder finds conflict before writer proceeds
### Case 3: No Argument — Usage guidance shown
### Case 4: Localization Compliance — localization-lead blocks on a non-translatable string
### Case 5: Writer Blocked — Missing character voice profiles
### Case 6: `review_mode` gates nothing but the `small` roster — ND-CONSISTENCY runs in every mode

definitions.name: team-audio
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — All steps complete, audio design document saved
### Case 2: Accessibility Gap — Critical gameplay audio event has no visual fallback
### Case 3: No Argument — Usage guidance or design doc inference
### Case 4: Missing Sound Bible — Skill notes the gap and proceeds without it
### Case 5: Engine Not Configured — Engine specialist step skipped and recorded
### Case 6: `review_mode` gates nothing — the same request at full, lean and solo

definitions.name: team-level
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — All team members produce outputs, document compiled and saved
### Case 2: Blocked Agent (world-builder) — Partial report produced with gap noted
### Case 3: No Argument — Usage guidance shown
### Case 4: Accessibility Review Gate — Blocking concern surfaces before sign-off
### Case 5: Circular Level Reference — Adjacent area dependency flagged

definitions.name: team-polish
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Full pipeline completes, READY FOR RELEASE verdict
### Case 2: Performance Blocker — Frame budget violation cannot be fully resolved
### Case 3: No Argument — Usage guidance shown
### Case 4: Engine-Level Bottleneck — engine-programmer spawned conditionally in Phase 2
### Case 5: Regression Found — Polish change broke an existing feature
### Case 6: No Budgets Committed — NOT ASSESSED, not READY FOR RELEASE
### Case 7: Default `individual` — the optimisation list is handed to `/dev-story`
### Case 8: Workflow Minimal — NEEDS MORE WORK goes to the brief's build order

definitions.name: team-release
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path (Single-Player) — All phases complete, version deployed
### Case 2: Go/No-Go: NO — S1 bug found in Phase 3, deployment skipped
### Case 3: Security Audit for Online Game — security-engineer is spawned in Phase 3
### Case 4: Localization Miss — Untranslated strings reach the go/no-go call
### Case 5: No Argument — Skill infers version or asks
### Case 6: Stage Still Polish — Stops Before Phase 1, Nothing Spawned

definitions.name: team-live-ops
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — All 7 phases complete, season plan produced
### Case 2: Ethics Violation Found — Reward element violates ethics policy
### Case 3: No Argument — Usage guidance shown
### Case 4: Parallel Phase Validation — Phases 3 and 4 run simultaneously
### Case 5: Missing Ethics Policy — `design/live-ops/ethics-policy.md` does not exist
### Case 6: Workflow Minimal — The sprint step becomes the brief's build order

definitions.name: team-qa
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — All stories pass manual QA, APPROVED verdict
### Case 2: Smoke Check Fail — QA cycle stops at Phase 2
### Case 3: Bug Found — Visual/Feel story fails manual QA, bug report filed
### Case 4: No Argument — Skill infers active sprint or asks user
### Case 5: Mixed Results — Some PASS, one FAIL with S1 bug, one BLOCKED
### Case 6: `qa.level: minimal` — a Logic story with no test is evidenced by its acceptance-criteria walk
### Case 7: Smoke report NOT ASSESSED — continue with a warning, sign-off NOT ASSESSED
### Case 8: An open S1 already on file — known before sign-off, and the brief names no verdict
### Case 9: `review_mode` gates nothing — the same cycle at full, lean and solo

definitions.name: skill-test
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Static Mode — Well-formed skill, all 7 checks pass, COMPLIANT
### Case 2: Static Mode — Skill Missing Ask-Before-Write Despite Write Tool in allowed-tools
### Case 3: Spec Mode — gate-check Skill Evaluated Against Its Spec
### Case 4: Audit Mode — Coverage Table of All Skills and Agents
### Case 5: Category Mode — Gate Skill Evaluated Against Quality Rubric
### Case 6: Spec Mode — Agent Name Resolves to the Agent
### Case 7: Static All — an unreadable skill is NOT ASSESSED and counted
### Case 8: Spec Mode — an unevaluable assertion makes the run NOT ASSESSED
### Case 9: Category Mode — no rubric section for the category
### Case 10: Static Mode — a split skill is read whole, but its frontmatter comes from SKILL.md

definitions.name: skill-improve
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Check 4 FAIL and Check 5 WARN fixed, changes kept
### Case 2: Fix Causes Regression — revert offered, runs only on yes
### Case 3: Gate Skill — combined static + category baseline
### Case 4: Skill Already Clean — No improvements needed
### Case 5: Director Gate Check — No gate; skill-improve is a meta utility
### Case 6: Equal Score — "no change" does not keep the fix as an improvement
### Case 7: Split Skill Regression — every file named, recorded and restored

definitions.name: start
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Fresh repo, Path A, rigor inferred
### Case 2: Returning User — Onboarding skipped
### Case 3: Existing Work on Unity — Path D, stage from the files, rigor already set
### Case 4: Clone Still Wired to the Template Repo — remote note, never run
### Case 5: Director Gate Check — No gate; start is a utility setup skill
### Case 6: Path D With Rigor Unset — inferred from the description, not asked
### Case 7: Existing `modes:` Block — rigor and automation go into it, never a second one
### Case 8: Path D at `minimal` With No Brief — names where the brief comes from

definitions.name: help
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Production stage with active sprint
### Case 2: Concept Stage — engine configured, no concept document
### Case 3: No stage recorded — phase inferred from artifacts
### Case 4: Argument — user names the step they finished and says they are unsure
### Case 5: Director Gate Check — minimal path, no gate and no gate-check route
### Case 6: Minimal path — the checkpoint says the work is written
### Case 7: Minimal path — only a blocked story and an unknown status remain
### Case 8: Minimal path, no game brief — a built game is documented, not re-brainstormed

definitions.name: brainstorm
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Full mode, 3 concepts, gates at their three points
### Case 2: Failure Path — CD-PILLARS returns REJECT
### Case 3: Lean Mode — All 4 gates skipped with named notes
### Case 4: Solo Default — Minimal tier runs the Lean Brief flow
### Case 5: Director Gate — PR-SCOPE returns UNREALISTIC
### Case 6: Solo Review on the Full Flow — All 4 gates skipped with Solo-mode notes

definitions.name: project-stage-detect
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Configured Stage Matches the Artifacts
### Case 2: No Configured Stage — Inferred From Artifacts, Role Filter Applied
### Case 3: Configured Stage Contradicted by the Artifacts
### Case 4: Minimal Workflow Tier — Absent Docs Are Not Gaps
### Case 5: Director Gate Check — None; Declined Write Leaves No File
### Case 6: Unresolved Code Root — NOT ASSESSED, not a greenfield project
### Case 7: Minimal Workflow, No Game Brief — The follow-up depends on how much code exists

definitions.name: setup-engine
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Godot 4 + GDScript — Full engine configuration
### Case 2: Unity + C# — Unity-specific configuration
### Case 3: Unreal — C++ primary, Blueprint routed to its specialist
### Case 4: Re-run on a Configured Project — blocks edited in place
### Case 5: Director Gate Check — No gate; setup-engine is a utility skill
### Case 6: Installed Editor Older Than the Chosen Version — ask, then record
### Case 7: Godot not on PATH — the probed executable goes into `commands.*`
### Case 8: A skipped question is not an answer

definitions.name: quick-design
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Tweak to an existing system
### Case 2: Failure Path — Scope too large; redirected to /design-system
### Case 3: Edge Case — Tuning change outside the documented knob range
### Case 4: Edge Case — No argument and no systems index
### Case 5: No Director Gates — Review mode has no effect
### Case 6: Edge Case — No GDD for the system (the default tier)

definitions.name: ux-design
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — New HUD design
### Case 2: Existing Document — Retrofit of incomplete sections only
### Case 3: Missing Context — No game concept and no player journey
### Case 4: No Argument Provided — Ask instead of failing
### Case 5: No Director Gate — `/ux-review` is the separate review
### Case 6: Handoff — names the Production gate and what the review requirement depends on

definitions.name: ux-review
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Complete UX spec, APPROVED
### Case 2: Empty Accessibility Section — NEEDS REVISION
### Case 3: Incomplete States — NEEDS REVISION outranks NOT ASSESSED
### Case 4: Nothing to Assess Against — NOT ASSESSED
### Case 5: `all` Argument and No Director Gate

definitions.name: art-bible
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Full mode, full workflow, all nine sections, AD-ART-BIBLE approves
### Case 2: AD-ART-BIBLE Returns CONCERNS or NOT ASSESSED
### Case 3: Lean Mode, Standard Workflow — Core sections only, gate skipped
### Case 4: Existing Art Bible — Retrofit of incomplete sections only
### Case 5: Solo Mode and Missing Concept

definitions.name: create-architecture
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — New architecture document, full mode, reviews approve
### Case 2: Review Concerns — LP-FEASIBILITY returns CONCERNS
### Case 3: Lean and Solo Modes — Both reviews skipped, written with user approval only
### Case 3b: Review Rejects — Accept Is Not Offered
### Case 4: Edge Case — Systems index missing or empty
### Case 5: ADR Audit — Proposed ADRs and uncovered requirements
### Case 6: Existing Architecture Document — Update in place, never overwritten unasked
### Case 7: Re-run with a TR registry — registered IDs are reused, new ones are provisional

definitions.name: code-review
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Standards-compliant file that follows its ADR
### Case 2: Changes Required — Missing doc comments and singleton usage, no ADR
### Case 3: Architectural Violation — Code uses a pattern its ADR rejects
### Case 4: Edge Case — No source files at the specified path
### Case 5: No Engine Configured — Skipped specialists announce themselves; no gate
### Case 5b: No Engine Configured, Clean File — NOT ASSESSED, never APPROVED
### Case 6: Referenced ADR missing — the section's NOT ASSESSED reaches the verdict

definitions.name: balance-check
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — All balance values within their intended ranges
### Case 2: Outlier — Player damage far above its intended range
### Case 3: No Design Targets — Data exists but no GDD or registry defines the ranges
### Case 4: Registry First — The registry value overrides a contradicting GDD
### Case 5: No Argument, Gate Compliance and the Save Path
### Case 6: Orphan Stat — A data value no GDD or registry defines

definitions.name: asset-audit
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — All assets follow naming conventions
### Case 2: Non-Compliant — Textures exceed size budget
### Case 3: Format Issue — Music in wrong format
### Case 4: Missing Asset — Referenced by code but absent from assets/
### Case 5: No Data — No assets and no asset standards
### Case 6: Zero Assets — Standards exist, nothing to audit
### Case 7: No Standards — Assets exist, no size budget anywhere
### Case 8: Unreal Project — Assets under `Content/`
### Case 9: Engine Unresolved — Stop before scanning

definitions.name: content-audit
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — All specified content present
### Case 2: Gaps Found — MVP enemy content barely started
### Case 3: No Design Inputs — Nothing to audit against
### Case 3b: No Counts Anywhere — GDDs exist but none gives a count
### Case 4: Edge Case — A pre-Summary GDD describes content without a count
### Case 5: Gate Compliance — No gate; optional report requires approval
### Case 6: Standard Workflow — Only counts in the required sections are audited
### Case 7: Minimal Workflow — No systems index to audit against
### Case 8: Code Root Unresolved — The level count is not taken

definitions.name: tech-debt
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Scan appends new findings to an existing register
### Case 2: No Subcommand — Usage and FAIL
### Case 3: Empty Code Root — NOT ASSESSED, not a clean scan
### Case 3b: Code Root Unresolved — NOT ASSESSED, nothing scanned on a guess
### Case 4: Add Mode — User declines the write
### Case 4a: Add Mode — Matches an Existing Open Entry
### Case 4b: Report Mode Without a Register — NOT ASSESSED
### Case 5: Prioritize in Full Review Mode — Scored, re-sorted, approved
### Case 5b: Prioritize at Workflow Minimal — Build next, not a sprint

definitions.name: scope-check
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Multi-word feature on track
### Case 2: Significant Creep — Sprint gained unplanned items
### Case 3: Baseline Missing — Report the missing file and stop
### Case 4: Empty Baseline — NOT ASSESSED, not 0%
### Case 4b: Unreadable Current State — NOT ASSESSED, not −100%
### Case 5: Minor Creep in Full Review Mode — CONCERNS, no gates

definitions.name: estimate
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Clear task in a documented system with existing patterns
### Case 2: High Uncertainty — New subsystem, no architecture decided
### Case 3: No Sprint Velocity Data — Estimate still produced, gap stated
### Case 4: Vague Task — Clarification before estimating
### Case 5: Gate Compliance — No gate; estimates are informational

definitions.name: perf-profile
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Budgets committed, combat hotspots found
### Case 2: No Committed Budget — Budget rows are NOT ASSESSED
### Case 3: Nothing to Profile — Whole verdict NOT ASSESSED — NO DATA
### Case 4: Local Enforcement Override `block` — Violations are blockers
### Case 5: Enforcement Level `off` in Full Review Mode — Informational only, no gates
### Case 6: `workflow` — where an accepted optimization goes
### Case 7: Session Started in a Subfolder — budgets are still read from the project root

definitions.name: security-audit
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Single-player Godot project, no findings
### Case 1b: Single-player, One HIGH Finding — FIX BEFORE SHIPPING
### Case 2: Multiplayer Critical — Client-authoritative RPC and a hardcoded key
### Case 3: Multiplayer Scope Unset — Absent is not `false`
### Case 4: No Implemented Surface — NOT ASSESSED — INSUFFICIENT IMPLEMENTATION
### Case 5: Unity Project in Full Review Mode — NOT SOURCEABLE category, no gates
### Case 5b: Ranking — An open HIGH outranks an unsourced category

definitions.name: test-evidence-review
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Single Logic story with a strong test
### Case 2: Vacuous and Thin Tests — INCOMPLETE with a BLOCKING item
### Case 3: Empty Sprint Scope at Minimal Workflow — NOT ASSESSED, not a clean report
### Case 4: Story Type Unknown — Per-story NOT ASSESSED lifts the overall verdict
### Case 5: Visual/Feel Evidence Without a Retained Screenshot, Full Review Mode — No gates
### Case 6: UI Story Closed by Its Screenshots — No Sign-Off Required
### Case 7: Unity Logic Story — Evidence at the Stated Engine Path
### Case 8: No Test for a Logic Story — MISSING, and it outranks NOT ASSESSED
### Case 9: `qa.level: minimal` — a Logic Story With No Test Is WAIVED; a UI Screenshot Is Not

definitions.name: test-flakiness
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — High flakiness from JUnit history, quarantined on approval
### Case 2: Moderate Flakiness — Fix directly, do not quarantine
### Case 3: No Result Data — List options and stop
### Case 4: Too Few Runs — Suspected, not confirmed
### Case 5: Registry Mode in Full Review Mode — Guidance for known quarantined tests, no gates

definitions.name: reverse-document
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Well-Structured Source at `full` — 8-section GDD produced
### Case 2: Unanswered Intent — INTENT UNKNOWN carried into the draft
### Case 3: Architecture Type on Interdependent Files — tier-independent ADR
### Case 4: Thin Source — Sufficiency check stops the run
### Case 5: Director Gate Check — No gate; declined write is BLOCKED
### Case 6: Default Tier — a single system becomes a one-page brief
### Case 7: Minimal Tier, Path Is the Code Root — the whole-game brief

definitions.name: bug-report
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — User describes a crash, full report produced
### Case 2: No Argument — Asks for a description before drafting
### Case 3: Close Mode — Bug not yet verified is refused
### Case 4: Multi-System Bug — One report, primary and related systems
### Case 5: Director Gate Check — Analyze Mode, no gate
### Case 6: Verify Mode — older three-digit file found by its number, CANNOT VERIFY
### Case 7: Verify then Close — no test covers the bug, the user's play settles it

definitions.name: hotfix
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — S1 crash fixed with record, branch, approvals and backport
### Case 2: Sign-off REJECT — Deployment blocked
### Case 3: Release Branch — Deploy approval holds even in autonomous mode
### Case 4: Not an Emergency — a cosmetic S4 redirected before any work
### Case 5: Director Gate Check — Producer sign-off, and NOT ASSESSED QA is not a pass
### Case 6: Smoke Check FAIL — back to Phase 4, and a CONCERNS sign-off still blocks

definitions.name: prototype
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Engine Prototype, PROCEED
### Case 2: PIVOT — Carry-Forward Note Written
### Case 3: KILL — Soundness Check and Graveyard Entry
### Case 4: Spike Mode — No Debrief, No Gate, No PROCEED/PIVOT/KILL
### Case 5: Director Gate — CD-PLAYTEST by Review Mode and Pillars
### Case 6: NOT ASSESSED (Unplayed) and the `workflow: minimal` PROCEED Route
### Case 7: Spike Mode at `workflow: minimal` — the build order, not a sprint

definitions.name: playtest-report
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Analyze Notes, Findings Routed by Bucket

definitions.name: milestone-review

definitions.name: retrospective

### Case 5: Gate Compliance — No gate invoked in any mode

definitions.name: changelog

### Case 2: No Git Tags Found — Bounded range used

### Case 4: Existing CHANGELOG.md — New entry at the top, old entries preserved
### Case 5: Gate Compliance — No gate; declined write ends COMPLETE
### Case 6: Provenance Stop — Zero Game commits
### Case 7: No History — Not a git repository

definitions.name: patch-notes

### Case 5: Gate Compliance — No gate; community-manager is separate
### Case 6: Provenance Stop — Zero Game commits
### Case 7: No Changelog Data — No changelog and no git history

definitions.name: onboard

### Case 4: Edge Case — Programmer Role With an Unresolved Code Root
### Case 5: Director Gate Check — None; No Agents Spawned

definitions.name: localize

### Case 5: Director Gate Check — None; Cultural Review Uses localization-lead
### Case 6: Scan With an Unresolved Code Root — NOT ASSESSED, never "no hardcoded strings"
### Case 7: QA on a Locale Nobody Has Played — NOT ASSESSED

definitions.name: launch-checklist
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Steam project, clean scans, every section confirmed, READY
### Case 2: Blocking Findings — FIXMEs and debug output
### Case 3: Cert Tier Unset — Ask, do not emit every track
### Case 4: Nothing to Scan — `[?]` items, not green ticks
### Case 5: Director Gate Check — Dry run, cert tier `none`
### Case 6: Stage Still Polish — Answers Make It CONDITIONAL, or NOT ASSESSED

definitions.name: release-checklist
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — PC Build on the Steam Tier
### Case 2: Device Argument and Certification Tier Are Separate Axes
### Case 3: cert_tier none vs Unset — Different Output
### Case 4: Edge Case — Nothing to Scan, No Test Output
### Case 5: Director Gate Check — None; Sign-Offs Are Listed, Not Spawned
### Case 6: A Known Blocker Outranks an Unassessed Section
### Case 7: Bug Thresholds Follow the Workflow Tier
### Case 8: No Bug Records — NOT ASSESSED, Not Zero

definitions.name: adopt
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — All GDDs compliant, no BLOCKING or HIGH gaps
### Case 2: Non-Compliant Documents — GDDs missing sections, BLOCKING and HIGH gaps
### Case 3: Mixed State — Some docs compliant, some not, partial report
### Case 4: No Artifacts Found — Fresh project, guidance to run /start
### Case 5: Director Gate Check — No gate; minimal tier scopes the audit to the brief
### Case 6: v1.0 Project — Converter run, never hand-migrated

definitions.name: smoke-check
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Automated tests pass, manual items confirmed, PASS
### Case 2: Failure Path — Automated test fails, blocking FAIL
### Case 3: Manual Confirmation — MISSING coverage, PASS WITH WARNINGS
### Case 4: Scaffold Without Game Tests — NOT ASSESSED, then stop
### Case 4b: No Game Tests at `qa.level: minimal` — WAIVED, the build carries the verdict
### Case 5: Director Gate Check — No gate; smoke-check is a QA pre-check utility
### Case 6: gdUnit4 Lookalikes — exit 0 over zero tests, and exit 101
### Case 7: Timeout — the suite never completed, FAIL
### Case 8: Batch 3 Skipped — NOT ASSESSED, not PASS
### Case 9: Unity — Play Mode is a second run
### Case 10: `quick` — no coverage scan, no Batch 3
### Case 11: `--platform` — platform batches and a per-platform verdict table
### Case 12: Phase files — each `references/` file is read before its phase, and again after compaction

definitions.name: soak-test
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — 2-hour, all-focus soak on Godot
### Case 2: No Arguments — Defaults applied
### Case 3: Narrow Focus on Unreal — 4-hour memory soak
### Case 4: No Performance Budgets — "not set", never invented
### Case 5: Director Gate Check — No gate; soak-test is a planning utility
### Case 6: Minimal workflow — the run steps end with `/bug-triage full`

definitions.name: test-setup
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — Godot project, scaffolds GdUnit4 test structure
### Case 2: Unity Project — Scaffolds Unity Test Runner with asmdef
### Case 3: Infrastructure Already Exists — Early exit, nothing re-initialized
### Case 4: No Engine Configured — Redirects to /setup-engine
### Case 5: Director Gate Check — No gate; test-setup is a scaffolding utility

definitions.name: test-helpers

### Case 4: Framework Assertion API Unconfirmed — No helper generated
### Case 5: Director Gate Check — No gate; test-helpers is a scaffolding utility
### Case 6: Unity — Helpers under the engine's test root

definitions.name: regression-suite

definitions.name: day-one-patch

definitions.name: settings
spec_cases: ### Case 1: Happy Path — view-all shows derived values, a local override and the legend

### Case 7: Reserved setting — stored on request, flagged on every form
### Case 8: Shadowed write and autonomous mode — still asked, with the shadow named
